snippet.title: PRESS: Authorized Disposal – Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Welcome to PRESS: Authorized Disposal. Manage a trash disposal factory where every new load needs to be pressed, burned or sorted — and where it might be better not to ask too many questions about what you're actually disposing of.

Complete contracts, upgrade your operation and above all else: keep the pit empty.

Wishlist PRESS: Authorized Disposal now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1372330/PRESS_Authorized_Disposal/
